GROUP1_TITLE_COMMENT: Title to show for GROUP1 (upper left corner) channel list.
GROUP1_SEARCH_COMMENT: Exact match and case insensitive search for GROUP1 channels.
GROUP2_TITLE_COMMENT: Title to show for GROUP2 (upper right corner) channel list.
GROUP2_SEARCH_COMMENT: For GROUP2, it will search for the prefix, case sensitive.
GROUP3_TITLE_COMMENT: Title to show for GROUP3 (lower left corner) channel list.
GROUP3_SEARCH_COMMENT: Exact match and case insensitive search for GROUP3 channels.
GROUP4_TITLE_COMMENT: Title to show for GROUP4 (lower right corner) channel list. Catch-all group - has no matching _SEARCH list; anything not matched by groups 1-3 lands here.
EXCLUDE_SEARCH_COMMENT: Exact match and case insensitive. Channels matching these names are never shown anywhere in the panel (not in any of the 4 lists, not selectable, not detected by the live sampler) - treated as if they don't exist.
EXCLUDE_PREFIX_SEARCH_COMMENT: Prefix match and case insensitive. Channels starting with any of these are never shown anywhere in the panel, same as EXCLUDE_SEARCH. Default excludes cryptomatte channels.
BACKDROP_TILE_COLOR_COMMENT: Backdrop fill color for rebuild backdrops (BackdropNode's tile_color knob, packed RGBA as a decimal int). Default is cyan.
BACKDROP_BORDER_WIDTH_COMMENT: Backdrop border thickness in pixels (BackdropNode's border_width knob).
BACKDROP_FONT_COLOR_COMMENT: Backdrop label text color (BackdropNode's note_font_color knob, packed RGBA as a decimal int). Default is white.
BACKDROP_FONT_SIZE_COMMENT: Backdrop label text size (BackdropNode's note_font_size knob).
user_settings_COMMENT: Editable via the Settings window (preferencesUI.ui) - keys match the widget object names they're saved/loaded from. Saving OVERWRITES this whole block with a fresh snapshot of every widget's value (see preferences.py), so don't add hand-written keys here that aren't backed by a widget - they won't survive the first save. BUTTON1-4_* and cfg_main_*_sep (direct pixel values, no hidden multiplier - see node_creation.py) drive node creation; cfg_sp_sampler_threshold seeds the main panel's live sampler (see sampler_controller.py); cfg_rs_* drive the subtractive rebuild (see rebuild_subtractive.py) - these are base units scaled x10 into actual pixel spacing, unlike cfg_main_*_sep.
